image_policy.wire: Inline base64 image_url in user input parts

timing_policy: Real continuous gameplay during HTTP; controls held until next answer. Initial expected age 10 frames, EMA old weight .65, new .35 of actual apply minus request frame. Six-frame minimum after applying each answer.

frame_age_policy.scope: Fresh independent EMA inside every run; no sharing across setups or starts.

selection_policy: Ten more Jev starts and ten more OpenAI text-only starts in randomized pairs. OpenAI text-plus-image already has thirty selected starts, so none are added here.
error_policy: No retries, fallback or replacement starts. Service errors and refusals during live play count failed starts. Settle and charge post-terminal in-flight calls without applying them.
